data.body:
Landed as 104dc4e10a (Gerrit change 1675, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted by RebarBotNava). The worktree was realigned onto gerrit/main and the ACs re-verified against the LANDED tree.

Implementation: review-code was wiring -- collect_step_failures() joins the code-review run scope beside collect_contract_violations(), and the coach op drains into the coverage it already builds, beside the contract-violation drain. verify-completion got the placement decided in the comment above: coverage.llm_step_failures, with the coverage object created ONLY when the tally is non-empty, drained in completion_reconcile just before validate_structured. Both verdict schemas now declare the block (copied verbatim from plan_review_verdict, required [total, by_step]); completion_verdict is additionalProperties:true, so that documents the key rather than unblocking it. The recording site was untouched -- every LLM call already funnels through the one runner seam.

Tests pin present/absent pairs on BOTH gates, and specifically that a clean completion run has no 'coverage' key at all (no empty container on a signed verdict). One test asserts each run scope actually opens a sink, so a drain that can never receive anything would be caught rather than passing silently.

CI took two rounds, neither caused by this change. (1) First Verified -1 was an infra flake: the lint job died at Makefile:221 actionlint-bin with curl error 56 downloading the binary, so lint exited 127 before running -- and this patchset touches no .github files. Rechecked with that reasoning. (2) The recheck then exposed a real STALE-BASE failure: the complexity-baseline lock reported a NEW entry for src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py::_update_one_dispatch_links, a file this change never touches, because main had moved to 7405e9657f ('Count cancelled link deletes as failed'). Rebased rather than rechecked -- the correct move for that signature -- after which check_complexity_baseline.py --check reported new=0 and all four pytest lanes went green.

Gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (512 files after rebase), full unit suite 9673 passed / 42 skipped, step-failure tests 16 passed on the landed tree. Touched files stay under the 800-LOC cap: gate_dispatch.py 731, gate_ops.py 349, code_review/workflow_ops.py 711.
